description: Run the OunceScout Smart Budget Stack Calculator to find the optimal physical Gold & Silver bullion stack for a target USD budget at today's lowest live dealer prices. Every result carries serve-time freshness stamps: checkedAt, priceAgeSeconds, and priceAgeBasis naming which price the age describes (priceAgeSeconds is null, with the basis explaining the data-as-of stamp, for tools that quote no price).

includeVaulted.description: Opt-in (default false): also consider vaulted products (metal held at the dealer's depository, e.g. Money Metals VaultSecure — storage fees apply and nothing is shipped to you). Vaulted picks are returned in a separate 'vaulted' section, never mixed into the shipped stack.

strategy.description: Allocation strategy: 'balanced' (Gold + Silver mix), 'gold' (Gold only), or 'silver' (Silver only).

name: calculate_budget_stack
title: Calculate Budget Stack
